title: Finance Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Operations Analyst to join our growing finance team. This role is essential to ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, from end-to-end payment execution and accounting control to tax compliance and audit-ready documentation.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in end-to-end payment processing, a strong understanding of the banking environment, experience with domestic and international transactions (FX payments), and the accounting knowledge required to accurately book and reconcile all financial movements. Additionally, this person will have a solid grasp of withholding tax requirements, the ability to issue service invoices (NFS-e), and a strong focus on internal controls and documentation processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and collaborate closely with teams in Brazil, Singapore, and Japan.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Payment Operations

  • Manage the full accounts payable cycle, including receiving, reviewing, and verifying invoices for accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Execute and monitor domestic and foreign currency (FX) payments, including supplier invoices, intercompany transactions, and service fees.
  • Operate banking platforms with accuracy and control, ensuring timely payment execution and proper approval workflows.
  • Track and manage payment terms, proactively resolving discrepancies and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate with BPO providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues and provide regular payment status updates.
  • Review, validate, and process employee reimbursement claims, ensuring policy compliance, complete documentation, and readiness for audits.
  • Support the continuous improvement of payment procedures and contribute to the development of updated policies and standard operating procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Tax and Invoicing

  • Identify, calculate, and control withholding taxes such as IRRF, ISS, PIS/COFINS, and INSS on supplier invoices and service payments.
  • Ensure proper tax treatment and accurate accounting of all transactions, including cross-border payments.
  • Prepare and issue service invoices (NFS-e) for intercompany and third-party transactions in compliance with municipal regulations and internal policies.
  • Support tax reconciliations, documentation, and reporting required for audits and statutory filings.

Accounting, Reporting, and Internal Controls

  • Accurately record, classify, and reconcile all payment transactions in the general ledger, ensuring proper accounting treatment.
  • Support the maintenance of the chart of accounts, including the creation and updating of GL accounts and cost centers.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare financial reporting packages for submission to the headquarters in Singapore.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing and organizing documentation that meets governance and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to building and strengthening internal controls, documentation standards, and compliance processes across all payment, accounting, and tax operations.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or above).
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in accounts payable, payment processing, treasury operations, accounting, or similar finance roles, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian payment processes, tax obligations, and withholding tax requirements.
  • Proven experience issuing service invoices (NFS-e) and ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FX payments, international transactions, and corporate banking platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Solid knowledge of internal controls, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams.

Why Join Us

  • You will be part of a dynamic finance team that plays a strategic role in our company’s expansion and operations in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in payments, accounting, tax compliance, and internal controls while contributing to the growth of a global organization with strong connections to Singapore and Japan.

SOBRE A ITALIEN

VIEMOS EM PAZ

Viemos em paz.

Somos italiens e viemos de uma outra dimensão.

Onde tudo é mais leve, mais suave, mais tranquilo.

Um lugar mágico, sem gravidade e sem conflitos.

Um lugar de paz.

Um lugar onde a vida não é feita de tempo,

o tempo é que é feito de vida.

Onde sentimos em qualquer canto

um encanto qualquer.

Viemos aqui para trazer pequenos momentos

de leveza na forma de deliciosos gelatos com

ingredientes italianos e brasileiros, combinados

com o melhor biscoito "waffle" belga do mundo

e caldas de outro planeta.

Um gelato leve, "leggero", com baixas calorias,

baixo teor de gordura e com pouca adição de açúcar.

Gelatos únicos no universo.

Venha viajar com a gente.

Livre-se do que te prende. Agarre-se ao que te move.

E o mais importante, seja qual for o seu caminho,

só leve com você o que for leve.

Sobre a empresa

Construtora líder no segmento popular e com atuação destacada no Médio/Alto Padrão no RS. Hoje com 6 canteiros ativos e plano de expansão para 10 canteiros até 2028 . Importante: a posição não é na Alfaiate Consultoria em Estratégia.

Missão do cargo

Responder pelo resultado integral da obra (prazo, custo, qualidade, segurança e escopo), coordenando equipes próprias e empreiteiros, garantindo aderência a projetos, contratos, cronograma e orçamento.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejamento & Prazo: detalhar e conduzir LPU/Lookahead/PPC , replanejar frentes, tratamento de restrições e interface com fornecedores.
  • Custo & Medições: controlar orçamento de obra, validar medições de empreiteiros , aprovar NFs , gerir perdas e estoques (suprimentos).
  • Qualidade: assegurar cumprimento de PIT/PTS , checklists, RDO e conformidade técnica; liderar tratativas de NCs e lições aprendidas.
  • Segurança: garantir aplicação dos procedimentos de SST , Permissões de Trabalho, DDS e indicadores de incidentes.
  • Contratos & Fornecedores: negociar escopos, mobilização, desempenho e reequilíbrios; cobrar cronogramas físico-financeiros.
  • Projetos & Compatibilização: gerir interferências entre arquitetura, complementares e “as built”; solicitar RFI e revisões.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: coordenar equipe de campo (mestres, técnicos, estagiários) e empreiteiros , com metas, ritos e feedbacks.
  • Relatórios & Rotina de Gestão: consolidar dashboard semanal (prazo/custo/qualidade/SST), reuniões com a coordenação/diretoria.
  • Entrega & Pós-obra: coordenar comissionamento, manual do proprietário, Vistoria de Entrega , pendências e transição para Assistência Técnica .

Indicadores (KPIs)

  • Aderência ao cronograma (variação % físico).
  • Custo x Orçado (desvio %) e giro de estoque .
  • Índice de retrabalho e não conformidades por etapa.
  • Taxa de incidentes/horas trabalhadas .
  • Produtividade por frente/empreiteiro.
  • Cumprimento do PPC e lead time de restrições.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil (concluída) e CREA ativo .
  • Experiência prévia como Engenheiro de Obra/Residente em edificações verticais e/ou paredes de concreto.
  • Domínio funcional de Excel e MS Project (ou Primavera); leitura de projetos e memoriais.
  • Residir em Porto Alegre/RS ou Região Metropolitana (eliminatório).
  • CNH B e disponibilidade para rotina de campo e eventuais sábados.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com Lean Construction/Last Planner (PPC) , BIM/compatibilização, paredes de concreto e sistemas industrializados.
  • Experiência com ERP/Sienge (ou similar), gestão de contratos e curvas S físico-financeiras.
  • Histórico de entrega com baixo desvio de custo e aderência de prazo .

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de dono e execução: decide, prioriza e entrega.
  • Organização e disciplina: ritos, padrões e registros impecáveis.
  • Comunicação e liderança: alinha frentes, dá feedback claro e desenvolve o time.
  • Análise crítica e dados: usa indicadores para ajustar rota.
  • Resiliência e segurança: mantém padrão sob pressão.

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado e senioridade.

  • Benefícios: vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde e auxílio combustível.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Provide professional HR advice to business management, supporting organizational development, talent retention, and performance improvement;

2. Lead employee relations management, effectively handling employee conflicts, disciplinary issues, and high-risk resignation cases;

3. Responsible for the full process management of employee departures, including termination negotiations, completion of exit formalities, calculation of compensation (such as FGTS, 13th salary, unused vacation leave conversion, etc.), ensuring full compliance and minimizing legal risks;

4. Manage the implementation of company attendance policies, oversee the operation of the clock-in system, review records of overtime, compensatory leave, and absences, and collaborate with the payroll team to ensure data accuracy;

Maintain the Human Resources Information System (HRIS), generate regular human resources data reports, and support decision-making analysis;

Job requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources, Management, Psychology, Law, or related fields;

2-5 years of relevant experience in human resources, with preference given to candidates who have worked in foreign enterprises, multinational corporations, or large local companies;

3. Proficient in the six major modules of human resources, with solid general HR knowledge and practical experience;

4. Possess extensive experience in offboarding management, familiar with the relevant provisions of Brazil's Consolidated Labor Laws (CLT), and capable of independently handling complex termination processes;

5. Possess practical experience in attendance and timekeeping management, with familiarity in working hour systems, overtime approval processes, and flexible work arrangements;

Fluent in English listening, speaking, reading, and writing, capable of conducting meetings, handling email correspondence, and drafting reports in English (it is recommended to include a fully English assessment session during the interview);

6. Proficient in using Office productivity software , with priority given to those familiar with mainstream HR systems;

7. Possess strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and cross-cultural sensitivity.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.

Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Company Description

RockSpoon is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team on-site in São Paulo. In this leadership role, you will craft and oversee user experiences that are exceptionally intuitive, requiring no training or tooltips for users. You will champion a design philosophy that emphasizes clarity, minimalism, and intuitive design thinking to achieve outstanding usability across our product line. Working across our cross-platform suite (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), you will leverage effective visual hierarchy, layout, and interaction cues to guide users effortlessly. This full-time position involves collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers; you will also mentor team members and shape our design system to deliver an exceptional user experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead intuitive UX design: Lead the design of clear, self-explanatory user interfaces and workflows. Leverage visual hierarchy, layout, and intuitive interaction cues to guide users, ensuring the product is so intuitive that no training or tooltips are needed.
  • Product design strategy: Drive the UX/UI design strategy with a strong focus on usability, minimalism, and intuitive design principles. Align design objectives with product goals to deliver a simple, elegant, and highly usable experience for users.
  • Cross-platform oversight: Oversee and contribute to the design of features across mobile and desktop platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Ensure a consistent, seamless user experience that respects platform-specific guidelines while maintaining a unified product identity.
  • Design and prototyping: Create detailed wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design concepts. Iterate quickly based on feedback and usability findings to refine the user experience.
  • Design system ownership: Own and evolve RockSpoon’s design system and style guides. Establish UI standards and reusable components that promote a cohesive, intuitive, and minimalist interface across all products.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders from concept through launch. Ensure feasibility of designs and a smooth handoff to development, while advocating for the best user experience.
  • Mentorship and leadership: Mentor and provide guidance to mid-level and junior designers. Foster a culture of user-centered, intuitive design thinking within the team through knowledge sharing, code/design reviews, and continuous feedback.
  • User research & testing: Champion user research and usability testing efforts. Plan or participate in user interviews, UI tests, and analytics reviews to validate design decisions, using insights to continuously improve the product’s clarity and ease of use.
  • Usability and accessibility standards: Ensure all designs meet high standards for usability and accessibility. Deliver a frictionless, responsive experience for a diverse user base, and refine interactions to eliminate pain points and confusion.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a similar role, with significant experience leading design projects or initiatives. Proven track record of delivering successful and intuitive digital products or features.
  • Portfolio: An outstanding portfolio showcasing your product design work. Should include examples of complex applications you’ve made simple through intuitive design, demonstrating excellent usability, visual clarity, and minimalistic style.
  • Expert UX/UI knowledge: Deep knowledge of user experience principles and interaction design. Comfortable with information architecture, user flows, and usability heuristics. Ability to simplify complex workflows and create interfaces that feel natural to users.
  • Cross-platform expertise: Extensive experience designing for a range of platforms – native mobile (iOS and Android) and web/desktop applications. Familiarity with the best practices and constraints of each platform, and ability to create cohesive experiences across them.
  • Design tools & systems: Mastery of design and prototyping tools, especially Figma. Strong experience in building or maintaining design systems and component libraries. Able to enforce and evolve a consistent design language at scale.
  • Leadership & collaboration: Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead design discussions, clearly communicate design rationale, and influence product strategy. Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams and working closely with engineering and product management.
  • Intuitive design mindset: Demonstrated intuitive design thinking and problem-solving ability. Passion for usability and minimalism – you instinctively design solutions that feel easy and obvious to the end user, without extraneous complexity.
  • Communication & language: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (required for daily use). Portuguese language skills are a plus and will be helpful in the local office environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: (Contract) Psychotherapist / Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)

Location: Marau, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Marau.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:

Members Come First We are genuine member advocates.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Técnico de vendas Pleno- OTO (Da oferta até o pedido)
description:
A Cassioli Group é um grupo internacional especializado no projeto e na realização de soluções para automação e movimentação industrial.

Apoiamos empresas em todo o mundo na otimização de seus processos produtivos, desde o armazenamento até a produção, por meio de sistemas automáticos avançados e personalizados.

Nossa presença global, com sedes na Itália, Polônia, Brasil, Estados Unidos e Espanha, nos permite acompanhar os clientes em todas as fases do projeto, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e um serviço de assistência técnica constante.

Posição: Técnico de Vendas Pleno – OTO (Da oferta até o pedido).

Descrição das atividades:

  • Verificar tecnicamente necessidade do cliente (Consultar manuais, catálogos, desenhos técnicos, esquemas elétricos e especificação técnica de funcionamento para definição do produto e realizar contato com time de engenharia mecânica e elétrica para suporte caso acha um vício no equipamento);
  • Esclarecer dados técnicos do produto ao cliente;
  • Estabelecer prazos de entrega dos produtos;
  • Calcular custo do produto (Calcular custo de acordo com desenho técnico/ de acordo com histórico de compra e venda/ contatar fornecedores para solicitação de ofertas);
  • Verificar ficha cadastral do cliente;
  • Participar de reuniões internas e com clientes;
  • Apresentar proposta ao cliente;
  • Explicar formas de pagamento;
  • Realizar verificação e conferência do pedido de compra enviado versus oferta e solicitar ajustes ao cliente;
  • Realizar cadastro de estrutura do produto vendido;
  • Transmitir pedido de venda à produção/ estoque e aos setores correlatos conforme procedimento;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas da oferta/ pedido;
  • Comunicar aos clientes alterações nos produtos e/ou serviços;
  • Sugerir melhorias ao processo promocional e comercial;
  • Elaborar relatórios e estatísticas;
  • Controlar vendas efetuadas;
  • Informar ao superior resultados de vendas;
  • Requisitar assistência técnica;
  • Requisitar material de consumo;
  • Requisitar material de divulgação;

Competências técnicas

  • Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico mecânico;
  • Leitura e interpretação de esquema elétrico;
  • Conhecimento básico em AutoCad 2D;
  • Conhecimento básico em Inventor/ Vault;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em vendas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em pacote office (Excel/ Outlook/ Word);

Perfil desejado

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Proatividade e orientação para resultados;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente multidisciplinar.

title: Finance business partner
description:
Responsibility:

1.Assist business team on the whole financial process, formulate and optimize financial processes and rules, provide professional financial advice and promote implementation. 2.Support financial matters for new countries/cities launch, ensure smooth business-related financial processes, and control financial risks.

3.Cooperate with professional financial teams such as accounting, tax, reporting, treasury, internal control, etc., to ensure all businesses comply with financial rules.

4.Evaluate the investment and expected return of new business, and provide financial support for business development.

5.Participate in the company's business plan related work, be responsible for the annual financial budget and rolling forecast, and conduct effective budget management together with the business.

6.Gain in-depth understanding of the business, work closely with business partners, establish an effective financial analysis system, conduct in-depth analysis of business operations, identify opportunities and indicate risks.

7.Participate in the construction of financial digitalization and put forward demands and suggestions from the perspective of analysis and monitoring.

Requirements:

1.Bachelor's degree or above, background in corporate finance, accounting, finance or related majors.

2.More than 5 years of experience in finance BP or related positions, familiar with MENA financial regulations.

3.Have a strong curiosity and entrepreneurial spirit, and eager to learn new things. Able to quickly adapt to new environments and job responsibilities.

4.Have good communication skills and team spirit, and can effectively coordinate and cooperate with different departments.

5.Proficient in using financial software, office software and statistical analysis methods, with good data processing and analysis capabilities.

6.Have a strong sense of responsibility and business sensitivity, think deeply, and possess skills in identifying and resolving issues.

7.Able to use English as the working language.

title: Operador Logístico
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF! Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance, da NWB, da OneFan e da X3M, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele? Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!

Sobre a posição no jogo:

Como Operador Logístico, você entrará em campo, com as seguintes atividades:

  • Receber, conferir e liberar pedidos do cliente conforme procedimento interno;
  • Distribuir pedidos na transportadora;
  • Localizar lotes de produtos quando necessário;
  • Manter o local limpo e organizado;
  • Fazer movimentação dos paletes e produtos;
  • Efetuar a liberação dos embarques;
  • Cuidar da conservação e bom uso dos equipamentos e outros recursos de trabalho da área.

O que você precisa para a posição no jogo:

  • Ensino médio completo ou cursando;
  • Ter mais de 18 anos;
  • Disposição para trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Facilidade para aprender;
  • Facilidade para se relacionar;
  • Comprometimento e organização;
  • Atenção aos detalhes.

OBS: Teremos fretados gratuitos saindo de: Atibaia, Bragança Paulista, Guarulhos, Extrema, Vargem, Terra Preta, Bom Jesus, Joanópolis, Mairiporã, Pinhalzinho e mais regiões.

Vista a camisa, entre em campo com a gente e faça parte da maior operação do ano.

title: ANALISTA DE ESTRATÉGIAS DE COBRANCA PL
description:

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

  • Planejamento e Otimização da Operação: Apoiar o planejamento de acionamentos e o desdobramento de metas, garantindo a acurácia da carga e a otimização de rotas de discagem.
  • Qualidade dos dados e das informações nos relatórios de performance. Analisar dados e relatórios para identificar padrões, desvios, otimizar campanhas e propor melhorias contínuas que visem o atingimento e a superação das metas.
  • Projetos e Apresentações: Apoiar no desenvolvimento de projetos estratégicos.
  • Análise de Indicadores de Cobrança: Monitorar e analisar os principais indicadores da esteira de cobrança, como Alô, CPC, Hit Rate, Conversão e Efetividade, propondo planos de ação para otimizar os resultados.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento com o Parceiro : Manter um relacionamento próximo com a equipe do parceiro. Apoiar nas discussões de resultados, desafios e oportunidades de automação e otimização das ferramentas, utilizando os relatórios de performance como base para essas discussões.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino super completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento prévio em estratégias de cobrança;
  • Conhecimento de indicadores de cobrança (PTP, PMR, Taxa de Recuperação, Hit Rate, Conversão e Efetividade);
  • Excel intermediário (Tabelas Dinâmicas, PROCs, Funções SE);
  • Relacionamento com escritórios parceiros.

Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em Power BI.

Informações adicionais

Modelo de trabalho híbrido sendo 3x por semana presencial e 2x home office.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Client Services Analyst
description:
Location: Pinheiros, São Paulo (On-site)

Webull (Nasdaq: BULL) is a leading digital investment platform built to empower investors through technology.

Founded with the mission to democratize finance, Webull offers advanced tools, data, and analytics that enable investors to make informed decisions.

Globally, Webull provides access to equities, options, ETFs, and other financial products across multiple markets.

Webull is headquartered in  New York City and operates in major financial centers around the world, including New York, London, Hong Kong, Singapore, Toronto, Amsterdam, and Sydney.

At  Webull Brazil , we are committed to providing our clients with the best customer experience possible, helping to strengthen the Firm’s position as an innovative leader in the investment industry.

About this Role

As a  Client Services Analyst , you will play a key role on the front lines, supporting clients across different product lines, ensuring efficient and accurate issue resolution, and contributing to the continuous improvement of our operational and servicing processes. Acting as an extension of our clients, you will help strengthen Webull’s position as an innovative leader in the investment industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer phones and communicate with clients via email and chat, resolving inquiries related to account opening, funding, withdrawals, transfers, margin, and trading.
  • Support client onboarding, ensuring accurate documentation review and timely account opening.
  • Assist clients across multiple product lines, including equities, options, crypto, and other financial products offered by Webull.
  • Monitor daily operational processes related to accounts, banking, and trading to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
  • Use client feedback to collaborate with internal teams (Product, Technology, Compliance, Operations) to streamline and improve processes.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of FAQs and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure service quality and consistency.
  • Continuously review and optimize operating procedures to maintain high service standards.
  • Follow all compliance and risk procedures, including documented risk controls and escalation protocols, while adhering to corporate and industry standards.
  • Support ad hoc initiatives such as process improvements, product testing, and service optimization projects.

Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • 2–5 years of experience in a relevant field (client services, fintech, brokerage, or financial services).
  • CPA-20 certification is a plus.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and verbal).
  • Strong sense of urgency, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and relationship management skills.
  • Motivated, proactive, and collaborative, with a positive and professional demeanor.

Skills

  • Motivated, proactive, and collaborative.
  • Excellent problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong prioritization skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work accurately under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and relationship management skills.
  • Positive, professional demeanor and sound judgment.

Benefits:

At  Webull Brazil , we provide a competitive compensation package and benefits designed to support both your professional and personal growth:

  • 100% employer-paid Medical and Dental Insurance.
  • Flash Benefits card.
  • Wellhub (or equivalent) membership for wellness and fitness.
  • Annual performance-based bonus.

All benefits required under Brazilian Labor Law (CLT).

Reports to: Customer Experience

Area: Operations

title: Técnico de vendas Pleno - OTC (Do pedido até o cliente)
description:
A Cassioli Group é um grupo internacional especializado no projeto e na realização de soluções para automação e movimentação industrial.

Apoiamos empresas em todo o mundo na otimização de seus processos produtivos, desde o armazenamento até a produção, por meio de sistemas automáticos avançados e personalizados.

Nossa presença global, com sedes na Itália, Polônia, Brasil, Estados Unidos e Espanha, nos permite acompanhar os clientes em todas as fases do projeto, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e um serviço de assistência técnica constante.

Posição: Técnico de vendas Pleno – OTC (Do pedido até o cliente)

Descrição das atividades:

  • Verificar tecnicamente as necessidades do cliente, consultando manuais, catálogos, desenhos técnicos, esquemas elétricos e especificações funcionais para definição do produto, e contatar as equipes de engenharia mecânica e elétrica para suporte quando necessário;

  • Estabelecer e controlar prazos de entrega dos produtos;
  • Informar o custo executado do produto com base nos pedidos e na produção realizada;
  • Verificar e atualizar a ficha cadastral do cliente;
  • Participar de reuniões internas e com clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Explicar condições e formas de pagamento;
  • Realizar ajustes no cadastro de estrutura dos produtos vendidos;
  • Criar e controlar cronogramas de entrega de peças e serviços do setor;
  • Solicitar a compra de materiais de embalagem;
  • Controlar e monitorar pedidos de venda em conjunto com os setores correlatos (produção, estoque, compras), garantindo que as entregas ocorram nas datas planejadas;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas referentes às ofertas e pedidos;
  • Comunicar aos clientes eventuais alterações nos produtos e/ou serviços;
  • Criar planos de ação e planos de recuperação quando houver atrasos na entrega de produtos ou serviços;
  • Solicitar documentos fiscais, documentos de exportação e de expedição;
  • Elaborar relatórios de acompanhamento de produção e expedição para os clientes;
  • Elaborar relatórios e estatísticas internas (quantidade de produtos e serviços entregues, atrasados, entre outros indicadores);
  • Enviar documentos de expedição para aprovação do cliente;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos administrativos, produtivos e comerciais;
  • Controlar processos e entregas efetuadas;
  • Informar ao superior imediato os resultados de entregas;
  • Requisitar assistência técnica, materiais de consumo e materiais de divulgação.

Competências técnicas:

  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos mecânicos ;
  • Leitura e interpretação de esquemas elétricos ;
  • Conhecimento básico em AutoCAD 2D ;
  • Conhecimento básico em Inventor / Vault ;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em vendas ;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em pacote Office (Excel / Outlook / Word).

Perfil desejado:

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em prazos;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Trabalho em equipe e espírito colaborativo.

Além disso, somos um dos maiores parceiros integrados ao iFood no Brasil sendo uma das Super Integradoras. Entregamos uma solução completa aos restaurantes do Ponto de Venda à Retaguarda.   • Criar e gerenciar o calendário de conteúdo para redes sociais, alinhando com os objetivos de marca e geração de demanda;
  • Produzir conteúdos relevantes em diferentes formatos (posts, vídeos, stories, artigos) para ampliar alcance, engajamento e apoiar a geração de negócios;

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions

2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy

3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base

REQUIRED EXPERTISE

1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)

2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing

3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management

Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.

WHAT WE OFFER

1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale

2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside

3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability

READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager
description:
About Dacxi Chain

Dacxi Chain is building the critical infrastructure for the future of global capital formation. As the world's first tokenized crowdfunding infrastructure, we're creating the foundational layer that enables entrepreneurs to connect with everyday investors worldwide through blockchain technology. By tokenizing company shares on our infrastructure, we're eliminating traditional barriers like geographical borders and limited liquidity - making capital raising seamless for businesses and investment opportunities accessible to everyone, everywhere. We're not just creating a platform; we're architecting the essential infrastructure that will power the next generation of crowdfunding - transparent, scalable, and globally accessible.

Job Description: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager

We are searching for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager to lead our most critical initiatives. This advanced hybrid role combines the governance of a PMO, the hands-on coordination of a Delivery Manager, and the technical depth of a Project Manager. You will also be entrusted with key Product Owner responsibilities, acting as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure projects are not only delivered on time and within budget but also align with our strategic product vision and maintain the highest quality standards.

Important: This role is only open to candidates based in Brazil , and requires fluent Portuguese and fluent English .

This is a fully remote position, working with teams across Brazil, the UK, and New Zealand.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Governance & Technical PMO:

  • Develop, refine, and enforce technical project management methodologies and best practices across the organization.
  • Manage and maintain a comprehensive RAID log, proactively identifying and mitigating potential roadblocks.
  • Maintain a decision log to document and track key project decisions, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  • Oversee an action log, holding all team members and stakeholders accountable for their commitments.
  • Implement "Planned vs. Actual" reporting to track project performance against initial baselines, highlighting deviations in scope, schedule, and budget.

Delivery & Release Management:

  • Serve as the central point of contact for project coordination, facilitating communication and collaboration between product, development, QA, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams across different time zones.
  • Partner with QA to ensure testing is integrated seamlessly into the project lifecycle, from early-stage validation to final quality assurance.
  • Coordinate with GTM teams to align on release schedules and ensure a smooth, well-prepared launch of new products or features.
  • Orchestrate and manage the end-to-end release process, ensuring all dependencies are met and risks are mitigated.
  • Hold product and engineering teams accountable for their commitments, ensuring deliverables are met on time and to the required standard.

Project & Product Ownership:

  • Lead the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning to execution and post-mortem analysis.
  • Act as the Product Owner for specific initiatives, ensuring the development team's work aligns with the overall product roadmap.
  • Translate business and user needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.
  • Proactively identify and address potential pitfalls, technical debt, and risks to ensure the project stays on track.
  • Provide high-quality, data-driven reporting to leadership and stakeholders, offering transparent insights into project status and performance.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a technical project management role, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Demonstrated experience with PMO functions, including process standardization, governance, and portfolio management.
  • Must be currently based in Brazil and fluent in both written and verbal Portuguese and English.
  • Expertise in managing project documentation, specifically RAID logs, decision logs, and action logs.
  • A track record of successfully holding cross-functional teams accountable for their deliverables.
  • Experience performing Product Owner duties, such as managing a product backlog and defining user stories.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of coordinating development, QA, and GTM teams across global locations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights from metrics like "planned vs. actual".
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or similar) are highly desirable.

Preferred Skills:

  • Innovative Mindset: A forward-thinking approach, staying ahead of industry and technology trends.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven decision-making approach.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to manage expectations and keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned.
  • Execution & Ownership: Strong sense of ownership, with a track record of driving complex projects to completion on time and to quality.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adjusting plans as priorities evolve.

This role is for a proactive leader who is passionate about both the big picture and the details. If you're ready to define processes, drive technical delivery, hold teams accountable, and help shape our product vision, we want to hear from you.

Interested?

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! Join us in revolutionizing the global funding landscape at Dacxi Chain.

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Oferecer suporte técnico laboratorial através do mapeamento e monitoramento dos processos, matérias-primas e produto, garantindo a confiabilidade dos dados analíticos, padronização de métodos e suporte à tomada de decisão na operação industrial. Gerir recursos, sistemas e realizar a gestão técnica dos analistas da sua área de atuação, contribuindo com projetos de melhoria contínua, inovação tecnológica e atendimento a requisitos normativos e de clientes. Assegurar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade e segurança, bem como, fornecer suporte técnico às demais áreas de interface.

Principais Atividades:

  • Profissional será responsável pela implementação, validação e otimização de metodologias analíticas , assegurando a qualidade e eficiência dos processos e produtos. Atuar na gestão de recursos laboratoriais , planejamento e acompanhamento de produção, com foco em conformidade técnica e regulatória;
  • Liderar o treinamento e capacitação da equipe , garantindo prontidão operacional e suporte técnico durante o startup da planta. Propor e executar melhorias contínuas por meio da análise de processos, adoção de novas tecnologias e práticas sustentáveis;
  • Realizar o monitoramento e supervisão das rotinas analíticas , controle de indicadores de desempenho e análise crítica de equipamentos e processos. Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de produção, manutenção, segurança e logística, colaborando em projetos de inovação, eficiência e qualidade;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar a gestão orçamentária do laboratório , negociação de contratos de manutenção e garantia da disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos sistemas. Comprometido com o cumprimento das normas de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (ISO, NRs) , promovendo uma cultura organizacional baseada em ética, conformidade e melhoria contínua.

title: Gerente de Loja - Shopping Jardim Sul (São Paulo-SP)
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!

Somos uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos colaboradores, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções.

Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

- Garantir a excelência no atendimento do cliente fidelizando o cliente com a marca e trazendo resultados para o atingimento de metas

- Acompanhar e orientar o time na jornada de vendas, interagindo e complementando quando visualiza oportunidades. Solucionar possíveis reclamações, trocas. Garantir que 100% da equipe realize os treinamentos online. Ser o multiplicador das estratégias da companhia, liderando pelo exemplo, sendo porta voz de todas as comunicações, garantindo a alta qualidade nos atendimentos

- Realizar o controle financeiro, fazendo depósitos semanais e preenchimento de planilhas, assim como controle do caixinha, prezando pelos gastos da loja afim de diminuir despesas. Coordenar a virada da operação a cada campanha dentro dos prazos e seguindo orientações da MMP (material de merchandising promocional) , além de manter a loja atrativa para o cliente (organização, precificação, limpeza, estrutura)

- Garantir o atingimento das metas e KPIs do time da loja, mantendo a rentabilidade dentro do esperado.

- Reportar diretamente ao Supervisor ou Gerente Distrital movimentações da concorrência, oportunidades da praça que a operação esta localizada, buscar parcerias na região. Participar das reuniões, construção de plano de ação, trabalhando estrategicamente no atingimento dos resultados. Buscar desenvolver o time em busca de um sucessor para a sua posição

-Realizar a gestão de todo o time, desenvolvendo e engajando os profissionais. Recrutar e selecionar funcionários para a equipe, reportar ao RH dados em relação ao ponto eletrônico e ser o principal vínculo com a área sempre que necessário para que o time esteja completo e munido de informações referente ao RH.

title: Product Designer Bilíngue
description:
cód. 54658

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

· Ei Dev, quer trabalhar em uma empresa com plano de carreira que coloca você como protagonista?

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Portfólio e estudos de caso evidenciando projetos anteriores, incluindo o processo de design e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar no ciclo completo do design de produto: descobrir, definir, desenhar e entregar soluções.
  • Experiência em aprimoramento contínuo da experiência do usuário (UX) , definição de métricas, identificação de problemas e propostas de melhoria.
  • Vivência com design system (preferencialmente Orquestra ou similares), colaborando na padronização e evolução dos componentes.
  • Vivência prévia comprovada em home broker e plataformas de renda variável.
  • Repertório em investimentos: conhecimento básico sobre mercado de ações, fundos de investimento, renda fixa e bitcoin .
  • Experiência prática ou pessoal como investidor em renda variável e criptoativos será considerada um diferencial.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Director - Sales Operations
description:
Estamos assessorando uma empresa Multinacional de grande porte na busca de um Sales Operations Director - Inglês fluente.

Como Diretor(a) de Operações de Vendas, você será um líder estratégico responsável por construir e expandir os sistemas, processos e a infraestrutura que sustentam nosso motor de go-to-market (GTM). Você trabalhará de forma colaborativa com as áreas de Vendas, Marketing, Sucesso do Cliente, Finanças e RH para impulsionar excelência operacional, acelerar o crescimento de receita e garantir visibilidade clara da performance ao longo de todo o ciclo de receita.

Essa posição é ideal para um profissional altamente analítico, colaborativo e orientado a sistemas, que se destaca em ambientes dinâmicos e de alto crescimento.

Responsabilidades Principais

1. Estratégia e Planejamento

• Desenvolver previsões de receita consistentes, baseadas em pipeline, histórico e cenário de mercado;

• Definir segmentação, territórios, metas e alocação de recursos de forma alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento;

• Estabelecer KPIs e garantir acompanhamento e reportes claros de performance;

2. Programas de Incentivo e Remuneração

• Desenhar planos de compensação comercial alinhados às metas do negócio.

• Definir e distribuir cotas com base em capacidade, potencial de mercado e dados históricos.

• Gerenciar sistemas de comissionamento e garantir transparência nos cálculos.

3. Pricing e Suporte Comercial

• Criar e manter modelos de precificação e pacotes comerciais competitivos e padronizados.

• Oferecer suporte a deals complexos, incluindo análise de margem e aprovação de condições especiais.

• Estabelecer políticas de descontos e governança para negociações.

4. Otimização de Processos

• Mapear e melhorar processos do ciclo lead-to-cash, reduzindo fricções;

• Alinhar processos entre Marketing, Vendas e Sucesso do Cliente, garantindo handoffs eficientes.

5. Dados e Relatórios

• Desenvolver dashboards e análises sobre pipeline, taxa de conversão, churn e metas;

• Garantir governança de dados e qualidade na utilização do CRM.

6. Sistemas e Ferramentas

• Participar da escolha, implementação e gestão de ferramentas como Salesforce e outras soluções de GTM;

• Configurar fluxos, automações e integrações que suportem processos escaláveis.

Requisitos

• Fluência em inglês;

• 7+ anos em Revenue Operations, Sales Operations ou Business Operations, incluindo liderança;

• Forte domínio de CRM (preferencialmente Salesforce) e ferramentas de GTM;

• Experiência comprovada em planejamento comercial, definição de territórios e cotas;

• Capacidade de influenciar múltiplas áreas e conduzir mudanças operacionais;

• Perfil analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados;

• Experiência em ambientes de alto crescimento, serviços, SaaS ou Tecnologia é desejável.

About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design

  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics
