title: Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur
description:
We’re Hiring!

Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.

Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.

We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION : Materials and Production Planning Specialist Conosur

LOCATION : São Paulo / Brazil

JOB TYPE : Permanent

ROLE SENIORITY : Managerial

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Coordinates production with tollers, ensuring alignment with the sales plan, efficient execution, and resolution of conflicts and delays. Plans and manages the availability of materials and active ingredients (AI), executing MRP calculations, purchasing, and logistics coordination with suppliers. Monitors inventory levels, intercompany transfers, and toller performance, supporting continuous improvement in collaboration with supply chain and procurement teams.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Owns toller coordination, ensuring production scheduling aligns with sales plan and demand priorities while maintaining adherence to frozen periods and committed production slots
  • Coordinates daily/weekly production plans with tollers, ensuring smooth execution by tracking output, resolving scheduling conflicts, and mitigating production delays. Works closely with the senior supply and planning specialist to align production priorities.
  • Monitors production execution, proactively identifying and addressing issues related to toller capacity, material shortages, or unexpected disruptions. Escalates unresolved risks to supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Owns material planning, ensures material availability of AI, co-formulants, and packaging readiness for planned production runs. Collaborates with suppliers and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Tracks and reports toller inventory levels, working with the Inventory Manager to identify potential shortages, excess stock, or discrepancies at toller sites.
  • Feeds production output data into ERP systems, ensuring visibility of completed batches and enabling accurate intercompany transfer orders, stock movements, and replenishment planning.
  • Collaborates with Logistics & Distribution, ensuring timely execution of intercompany transfers for finished goods and AI. Aligns outbound logistics, transportation planning, and carrier coordination to facilitate seamless material movement.
  • Provides input on toller performance, tracking adherence to schedules, production efficiency, and issue resolution. Supports continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with supply planning and procurement teams.
  • Runs MRP calculations daily/weekly, ensuring accurate material replenishment by validating planning parameters such as lead times, order quantities, and safety stock. Drives improvement in planning accuracy by refining MRP parameters based on supply performance.
  • Updates MRP with supplier feedback, incorporating changes in lead times, production constraints, and delivery schedules to ensure material availability. Works closely with suppliers to proactively adjust for potential delays and optimize material flow.
  • Manages procurement execution, creating and tracking purchase orders for direct materials and AI.
  • Communicates material requirements to suppliers, validating availability against forecasts and ensuring timely deliveries.
  • Coordinates material and AI call-offs, ensuring timely deliveries from suppliers while optimizing logistics flows in collaboration with Distribution & Logistics. Monitors transportation lead times and ensure alignment with toller production schedules.
  • Acts as secondary support as senior supply and planning specialist in Conosur and Brazil according to the business needs.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
  • APICS certification strongly recommended;
  • Post-graduation is desired;
  • Project Management skills;
  • 3+ years cumulative experience in Supply Chain Planning & Tollers; Inventory Management;
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Teamwork, Drives Results, Analytics, Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving;
  • Assertive Communication, Leadership and influencing skills required;
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems;
  • Required fluent Spanish and English;
  • Availability for travel (15%)

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

#Missão do Cargo:

Nossa squad de serviços está buscando Analista de Negócios para ajudar nossos clientes promovendo a cultura de inteligência sobre dados, visando otimizar tempo e recursos. Em troca, você pode esperar aprendizado e desenvolvimento, ajustados aos seus interesses e motivações.

Como analista de negócios o papel será atender os clientes internos ou externos da Neoway sempre buscando entender os fluxos de tecnologia e negócios dos produtos e planos de negócios das áreas atendidas, fomentando evolução/inovação/melhoria contínua onde aplicável. Entendimento e mapeamento de negócios, análise de negócios, exploração de dados, desenvolvimento de KPIs, discussão técnica referente às tecnologias utilizadas (Neoway e cliente) e ambientes analíticos para desenvolvimento de solução e maior.

#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Levantamento de Requisitos: Colaborar com diferentes áreas e stakeholders (internos e externos) para entender as necessidades de negócio, mapeando requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Análise de Processos: Estudar e propor melhorias nos processos de negócios da empresa, garantindo eficiência e aderência às melhores práticas.
  • Modelagem de Soluções: Definir e documentar soluções tecnológicas que atendam às demandas levantadas, colaborando com as equipes de desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Interface com Equipes Técnicas e de Produto: Traduzir as necessidades de negócios para as equipes técnicas e garantir que as funcionalidades desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com os requisitos; promovendo também novas tecnologias e metodologias que possam ser aplicadas ao portfólio de produtos da empresa, avaliando a viabilidade de sua implementação.
  • Acompanhamento de Projetos: Auxiliar no gerenciamento de projetos, assegurando a entrega no prazo e dentro do escopo, com foco na qualidade da solução entregue.
  • Análise de Dados e Performance: Monitorar KPIs (Indicadores- chave de Desempenho) e métricas relacionadas aos processos de negócio, recomendando ajustes quando necessário.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação clara e organizada sobre os processos e soluções implementadas.

#Requisitos:

  • Experiência em SQL, Python e outras ferramentas de análise de dados e de visualização de dados como Power BI, por exemplo.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos como o Jira;
  • Noções de integração de sistemas e APIs;
  • Familiaridade com Big Data, PySpark e modelos estatísticos.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para interação com diferentes áreas da empresa e clientes.
  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma eficiente e propor melhorias de processos.
  • Foco no Cliente: Entendimento das necessidades dos clientes e comprometimento em entregar soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Visão holística: de processos, do cliente e da Neoway para que possa atuar de forma crítica e propositiva/proativa;

#Diferencial:

  • Ter experiência com projetos de compliance, gestão de riscos, prevenção à fraudes e áreas correlatas;
  • Participação em projetos de Big Data focados nesses temas;
  • Certificações em compliance, gestão de riscos ou prevenção à fraudes serão um diferencial.

description:
I’m helping find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of Account Executive (Full Cycle) .

Responsibilities and more:

SaaS Sales for DatBot & Flipbooker • Selling to the U.S. market • PJ contractor

Why this role: Short cycles, clear ICP, good conversion, and uncapped commission on cash collected, with higher rates for self-sourced deals.

About us

We’re a lean U.S. SaaS company with products used by modern marketing teams. Engineering is in Brazil; sales targets the U.S. We value clear writing, fast experiments, and cash-in over vanity metrics.

Products

  • DatBot – AI workflows for agencies and SMBs to research, brief, and ship content faster.
  • Flipbooker – Turns PDFs into branded, gated microsites with analytics and access control.

The role

Full-cycle AE (hunter). You’ll prospect, run tight discovery, deliver short narrative demos, and close straightforward Team+ deals. Self-serve stays on the websites; you own outbound and expansions.

ICP (who you’ll sell)

U.S. SMB/mid-market: Heads/VPs of Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, eComm Managers, RevOps in non-regulated industries. Natural cross-sell between products.

What you’ll do

  • Self-source 60–80% of pipeline via email, phone, LinkedIn, and short Loom videos; re-engage warm leads quickly.
  • Run discovery (why change, impact, timeline ≤90 days), conduct a 5–8 minute demo, propose paid pilots, and close Team+ plans.
  • Build segmented lead lists and sequences; log clean notes; share weekly insights; surface cross-sell opportunities.
  • Drive a close plan on every late-stage opportunity, including dates, owners, legal, and security steps.

How we measure success

Ramp:

  • Month 1: 4–8 qualified meetings; 2–3 SAOs; 1 early win ideal.
  • Month 2: 12–18 qualified meetings; 6–8 SAOs; 1–3 wins.

Steady state (Month 3+): 12–20 qualified meetings; 6–10 SAOs; 2–4 wins per month.

Cash-in: US$8k–$15k+/month once ramped (grows as we dial in).

Quality gates: Show ≥70%; Show→SAO 45–60%; SAO→Win 20–35%.

You’ll be great here if you have:

  • Excellent English (spoken and written) for U.S. prospect calls.
  • 2+ years SaaS BDR/AE experience (U.S. SMB/mid-market a plus).
  • Real hunter skills: list building, smart personalization, tight copy, disciplined follow-up.
  • Tools experience: HubSpot, Apollo or similar, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Loom, Calendly, Google Workspace.

Compensation (uncapped, paid on cash collected)

  • Base (PJ): US$1.2k–1.8k/month + 25–40% on cash collected for self-sourced Team+ (≥US$2k ARR), 10–20% on assisted, with accelerators. Biweekly payouts. Attribution and tiers shared after the intro call; standard clawbacks for early churn.

Schedule: Remote in Brazil with ~3–4 hours overlap to U.S. ET/PT.

Engagement: PJ contractor.

Interview process

  • Intro screen: product pitch + quick funnel/OTE math.
  • Skills gauntlet: cold-call opener, discovery + 5–8 minute narrative demo, objection/negotiation.
  • Deal deep-dive with optional paid micro-trial if mutually useful.

title: Arquiteto de Domínio Redes
description:

Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Arquiteto de domínio Redes , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o projeto, a documentação e a evolução de arquiteturas de rede corporativas, industriais e de missão crítica para operações globais, subterrâneas, remotas, móveis/IoT e em nuvem/híbridas.

  • Experiência em automação de redes (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), monitoramento avançado (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excelência em documentação, desenho técnico, suporte à governança, integração multiplataforma e atuação internacional com equipes remotas.

Diferenciais:

Graduação em Sistemas ou áreas afins.

  • Experiência prévia no setor comercial/vendas;

  • CNH-B e disponibilidade para trabalho em campo quando necessário;
  • Desejável conhecimento de ERP Protheus.

title: Designer
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Designer to design and produce various online and offline promotional materials for our mobile phone brand. As the Designer, you will work closely with the marketing, branding, and sale teams to ensure brand consistency and create compelling visual assets that support product promotion and enhance brand awareness.Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Designer to design and produce various online and offline promotional materials for our mobile phone brand. As the Designer, you will work closely with the marketing, branding, and sale teams to ensure brand consistency and create compelling visual assets that support product promotion and enhance brand awareness.

Key Responsibilities:

Advertising and Promotional Materials Design:

  • Design and create a wide range of promotional materials, including but not limited to online ads (e.g., social media ads, web banners, Google Ads), offline promotional items (e.g., posters, banners, flyers), and multimedia presentations (e.g., videos, GIFs).
  • Ensure that all promotional materials align with the brand’s visual identity and effectively convey product information and brand values.

Digital Marketing Assets Design:

  • Create and localize visually engaging assets for digital marketing campaigns across social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, etc.), including posts, ads, cover images, and more.
  • Design visual content for email marketing campaigns, display ads, and in-app promotions to ensure cohesive branding across all digital marketing efforts.

Event and Exhibition Design:

  • Design visuals for offline events, exhibitions, and product launch events, including booth designs, posters, brochures, and signage, ensuring impactful brand presence.
  • Create visual concepts tailored to specific event themes while maintaining brand consistency and attractiveness.

Brand Consistency and Optimization:

  • Ensure that all marketing materials adhere to brand guidelines and maintain consistent visual style across all channels.
  • Continuously improve existing designs to enhance ad performance and provide an engaging visual experience for customers.

Cross-Team Collaboration:

  • Collaborate closely with marketing, product, and sales teams to understand business needs and provide design support for marketing campaigns.
  • Communicate with external ad agencies and printing vendors to ensure high-quality outputs and optimal printing results for promotional materials.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Visual Design, Graphic Design, Advertising Design, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience in design, preferably in consumer electronics (mobile phone industry experience is a plus).
  • Proficiency in design software (Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.), with video editing skills (Premiere, After Effects) being a plus.
  • Familiarity with the design requirements of digital and social media advertising, with a portfolio of successful digital marketing campaigns preferred
  • Strong creative abilities, capable of producing high-impact promotional designs based on brand positioning and market needs.
  • Excellent time management skills, able to handle multiple design projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand marketing needs and translate them into effective design solutions

title: Especialista em Controladoria
description:
A Oswaldo Cruz Química é uma das maiores empresas do setor químico da América Latina. Pertencente ao Grupo OCQ, foi criada em 1984 e desde então desenvolveu e produziu uma infinidade de resinas e demais matérias-primas que atendem aos mais importantes setores da economia, como construção civil, tintas, plásticos, papéis, setor têxtil, educação, higiene & beleza, madeira, setor agrícola, entre outros.

Na Oswaldo Cruz Química, nos desafiamos constantemente a buscar o novo, compartilhamos boas práticas e identificamos oportunidades para transformar o nosso dia a dia e de nossos clientes. Para isto, formamos um time repleto de pessoas criativas, colaborativas, com senso de dono e que colocam paixão em tudo o que fazem!

No Grupo OCQ valorizamos pessoas colaborativas, que possuem paixão por entregar, que cuidam dos relacionamentos, criativas e principalmente, com atitude de dono.

Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe. Valorizamos cada indivíduo, independentemente de sua etnia, cor, raça, religião, origem, idade, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra condição. description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a construção, manutenção e publicação de aplicações, serviços e componentes desenvolvidos na linguagem PowerBuilder, usando as ferramentas integradas de desenvolvimento Sybase PowerBuilder;
  • Apoiar a construção, manutenção e publicação de aplicações, serviços e componentes desenvolvidos na linguagem ASP.NET e C# .Net, usando a ferramenta integrada de desenvolvimento Microsoft Visual Studio .NET;
  • Apoiar a construção, manutenção e publicação de aplicações, serviços e componentes desenvolvidas na linguagem Active Server Pages (ASP) e Visual Basic 6.0 usando a ferramenta integrada de desenvolvimento Microsoft Visual InterDev e Microsoft Visual Studio 6.0 (SP6);
  • Atuar na configuração e publicação referente à integração entre aplicações distribuídas e computador central (Mainframe IBM) baseado em comunicação via Microsoft Host Integration Server (COMTI);
  • Atuar na publicação, manutenção e configuração de aplicações, serviços e componentes executados no Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) e Microsoft Componente Object Model (COM/COM+);
  • Atuar na configuração, ajustes e publicação de soluções que utilizem o serviço intermediário de mensagens Microsoft Message Queuing (MSMQ);
  • Atuar em rotina de análise de desempenho em servidores web, de aplicação e de processos, atuando de forma proativa na detecção de problemas;
  • Criar e fazer revisões de documentos de arquitetura;
  • Realizar modelagem de arquitetura de software utilizando Unified Modeling
  • Language (UML) com a elaboração de artefatos previstos no processo de desenvolvimento do Banco;
  • Desenvolver modelos para persistência de dados usando diagramas ER;
  • Desenvolver e executar projetos de arquitetura de software, relacionados com as tecnologias inerentes aos produtos, atuando nas fases de elaboração,construção e transição do processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Inspecionar e validar artefatos de Análise e Projeto utilizando o IBM Rational Software Architect;
  • Inspecionar código fonte relativo a plataforma Microsoft de acordo com regras definidas;
  • Criar procedimentos automatizados ou semiautomáticos para validação de artefatos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com prestação de serviços de suporte técnico especializado, instalação/configuração, treinamento ou desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando o produto Sybase PowerBuilder;
  • Possuir pelo menos uma das certificações técnicas a seguir:
  • Sybase PowerBuilder Developer Professional;
  • Sybase PowerBuilder Developer Professional Migration;
  • Sybase PowerBuilder Developer Associate;

title: Advogado(a) Pleno - Planejamento Patrimonial e Sucessório, Direito de Família e Sucessões
description:
A DGMSA é uma firma de advocacia que tem como principal missão assegurar a preservação do patrimônio afetivo e material da família empresária.

Somos especializados nos ramos do direito societário; contratual; tributário; imobiliário; e de família e sucessões. Nossos clientes possuem patrimônio no Brasil e no exterior.

Estamos sempre buscando melhorar a qualidade de nosso ambiente de trabalho, mediante exercício de uma cultura permanente de cuidado com as pessoas. A prova disso é que somos um dos poucos escritórios no Paraná que possuem o selo GPTW – Great Place To Work! e o prêmio de Melhores Empresas Para Trabalhar.

Nosso time vem crescendo e procuramos um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno para a autuação com Planejamento Patrimonial e Sucessório, Direito de Família e Sucessões.

EM QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ATUAR PRINCIPALMENTE?

  • Assessoria jurídica para pessoas físicas, famílias e empresas familiares, com abordagem multidisciplinar nas áreas de Direito de Família, Sucessões, Tributário e Societário;
  • Análise e estruturação de planilhas com informações patrimoniais;
  • Elaboração de testamentos (civil e vital);
  • Mediação em processos extrajudiciais de inventário e divórcios e elaboração dos acordos e escrituras públicas necessárias à efetivação de processos extrajudiciais de inventário e divórcios;
  • Elaboração de apresentação com estruturas e instrumentos de implementação de planejamento patrimonial e sucessório;
  • Desenvolvimento de instrumentos de governança corporativa e implementação de mecanismos para gestão de ativos familiares;
  • Elaboração de documentos societários de suporte à implementação das operações de planejamento patrimonial e sucessório;
  • Elaboração de acordos e protocolos familiares;
  • Assessoria em AGE / AGO / RCA; e
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes e parceiros.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Curso superior concluído antes de 2020;
  • Inscrição na OAB-PR;
  • Conhecimento intermediário:
  • em operações de planejamento patrimonial e sucessório;
  • na tributação incidente em operações de planejamento patrimonial e sucessório;
  • dos atos societários e contratuais normalmente utilizados na execução de operações de planejamento patrimonial e sucessório;
  • Experiência na elaboração, apresentação e execução de operações de planejamento sucessório;

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.

More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.

Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

title: Supervisor(a) Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA)
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Controle de Operações Agrícolas (COA).

Quais as responsabilidades?

Supervisionar as atividades relacionadas ao abastecimento de matéria prima de todas as unidades do grupo, garantindo a execução eficiente das operações da Torre de Controle CTT e Torre de Manutenção elevando a confiabilidade dos apontamos das classes de manutenção do grupo. Coordenar a equipe de operadores, assegurando que todas as metas de desempenho das áreas sejam alcançadas, realizando o acompanhamento diário das operações e implementando melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior completo em Engenharia Agronômica ou áreas afins;

Experiência em operações CTT e Torre de Manutenção;

Sólida vivência com indicadores de performance das operações e equipamentos;

Desejável conhecimento em sistemas como Simplefarm, Gatec, Solinftec, Logtrac;

Gestão de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Publishing Hunter is responsible for teaching and guiding new sellers to launch their first products on the SHEIN platform, ensuring they align with SHEIN’s policies and quality standards. This role plays a crucial part in the seamless transition of new sellers from onboarding to active selling status.

This role will be based in our office in São Paulo/Faria Lima. We are working 100% on-site.

Responsabilities:

  • Account and Product Verification: Lead the process of verifying new seller accounts and their product listings, ensuring compliance with SHEIN's policies and standards.
  • Publishing Guidance: Teach the new sellers about the seller’s interface on SHEIN platform, and guide them until they successfully publish the first product.
  • Quality Control: Oversee the quality control of product listings, working closely with the Quality Specialist to maintain high standards of product presentation and accuracy.
  • Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Work closely with the Hunting Support, Account Management, and Data Analytics teams to gather insights and feedback to continually improve the publishing process.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, E-Commerce, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 1 years of experience in e-commerce, product management, or a related field
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in CRM and product management software, with a strong understanding of e-commerce platforms and digital marketing principles.
  • Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a proactive approach to process improvement.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and Portuguese, with proficiency in Mandarin a plus.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

description:

O candidato ideal será responsável por todo o ciclo de entrega do projeto, coordenando entre as partes interessadas do cliente e as equipes de fornecedores, garantindo a execução bem-sucedida dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento estabelecidos.

title: Head of Operations (Portugal and Brazil)
description:
At MyCareforce, we’ve already connected 21,000+ nurses to 300+ healthcare units in Portugal and Brazil, covering nearly 1 million hours of care. Backed by $3.9M in funding, our mission is clear: improve the quality of healthcare shift by shift.

As Head of Operations, you’ll be responsible for boosting fullfillment performance and scaling team effectiveness across Portugal (mature market) and Brazil (fast-growing market). You’ll lead teams, design scalable processes, and work closely with Product and Sales to ensure reliability and growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and scale operations teams in Portugal and Brazil, ensuring clarity, accountability, and performance.
  • Drive marketplace KPIs: fulfillment rates, cancellations, retention, and response times.
  • Build scalable processes and playbooks to support rapid growth.
  • Work closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to align priorities and deliver results.
  • Use data and dashboards to spot bottlenecks and implement improvements.
  • Ensure compliance and operational excellence across both markets.

Your Profile

  • Experience leading operations in startups, marketplaces, or high-growth companies (healthtech is a plus).
  • Strong analytical mindset and KPI-driven decision-making.
  • Proven track record scaling teams and processes.
  • Hands-on, resilient, and comfortable in fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, able to align cross-functional teams.

The MyCareforce Way

  • Customer First – your success is measured by the success of the healthcare units we serve.
  • Commitment to Excellence – always ask: “Is this the best version?” before delivering.
  • Hustle through easy and hard times – when others slow down, we accelerate.
  • Act Like an Owner – don’t pass problems, solve them. Treat the company as if it’s your own.

What We Offer

  • The chance to shape and scale operations at a healthtech with global ambitions.
  • Direct impact on healthcare delivery in Portugal and Brazil.
  • Hybrid work setup in São Paulo.
  • Competitive package and growth opportunities (PJ + SOP).
  • A mission-driven culture that values ownership, speed, and excellence.

  • Realizar integração com as demais equipes de coordenação para que as entregas tenham consenso e melhor eficiência;
  • Realizar controle financeiro dos custos destinados às iniciativas de responsabilidade da engenharia;

description:

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript) to join our growing engineering team. You will work on high-impact projects, contributing to front-end and back-end solutions that demand scalability, maintainability, and architectural elegance.

This is not just about coding – we want someone who can design abstract solutions, implement complex features, and influence technical decisions that shape our platform for years to come.

  • Take ownership of complex features from concept to production.

Qualifications

  • ⁠Mandatory: Strong proficiency in TypeScript.

  • Mandatory: Experience in at least two front-end frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, Vue.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture patterns (DI, modularization, micro frontends, event-driven, etc.).

  • Strong grasp of CSS, HTML5, responsive design, and UI performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate in remote-first teams.

Nice to Have

  • ⁠Experience with microservices or event-driven architectures.

  • ⁠Knowledge of design systems and component-driven development.

A Green Farming Fazendas Renováveis é uma empresa brasileira especializada na produção de carne de alta qualidade, originária do cruzamento industrial de raças taurinas e zebuínas. Fundada com o objetivo de produzir carne de alto padrão na região do cerrado brasileiro, a empresa tem sede em Monte Alegre de Minas, MG.

Missão do Cargo:

O Zootecnista será o responsável técnico e operacional pela gestão completa do setor de confinamento, garantindo a máxima eficiência produtiva, o bem-estar animal e a qualidade da carne, por meio de um manejo nutricional, sanitário e de gestão de rebanho de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  1. Nutrição e Formulação de Dietas:
  • Formular e ajustar dietas de alto desempenho para as diferentes categorias de bovinos em engorda, visando o melhor custo-benefício e maximização do GPD (Ganho de Peso Diário).
  • Supervisionar e garantir o controle de qualidade e a correta mistura (homogeneidade) da ração na fábrica e nos vagões forrageiros.
  • Realizar a Leitura de Cocho (Escore de Cocho) diária, tomando decisões assertivas sobre o ajuste da quantidade e do tipo de dieta fornecida.
  • Gerenciar o estoque e a qualidade dos insumos (volumosos, concentrados, núcleos, aditivos).
  1. Manejo Zootécnico e Sanitário:
  • Planejar e executar o protocolo de chegada, adaptação e embarque dos animais.
  • Monitorar diariamente o estado de saúde e o bem-estar dos animais, identificando precocemente problemas sanitários e orientando o manejo do curral-hospital (em parceria com Médico Veterinário, se houver).
  • Gerenciar a formação e a lotação dos lotes de animais (separação por peso, sexo, escore corporal e/ou raça).
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de bem-estar animal e biosseguridade.
  1. Gestão de Pessoas e Infraestrutura:
  • Coordenar, treinar e supervisionar a equipe de trato e manejo do confinamento.
  • Garantir a manutenção e a funcionalidade das instalações (currais, cochos, bebedouros, fábrica de ração, pátio de compostagem).
  • Controlar o uso e a manutenção dos maquinários e equipamentos utilizados no manejo da alimentação.
  1. ﻿ Análise de Dados e Resultados:
  • Coletar, registrar e analisar dados de desempenho (Peso de Entrada/Saída, GPD, Conversão Alimentar, Rendimento de Carcaça).
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais de acompanhamento produtivo e financeiro para a diretoria.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão e softwares específicos para otimizar os processos do confinamento.

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Zootecnia (Obrigatório).

  • Domínio em formulação de dietas para bovinos de corte.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de gestão agropecuária e planilhas eletrônicas avançadas (Excel).

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Finance Analyst - Permanent Opportunity

Hybrid role - 2 - 3 Days in the office 2-3 days working from home

As the Finance Analyst, you will support the Brazil Subsidiary/Other Latam Distributor market and provide key management information. You will coordinate with the Central Finance team on a regular basis for Financial Planning and Analysis and Financial Controller support. You will play a pivot role in supporting the Lead, with all finance related matters in the Region.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare budget & forecasts and present the monthly analysis against actuals explaining the variation reasons for revenue, cost and fixed cost.
  • Liaison with all company departments for overhead deep analysis
  • Work alongside internal business teams and functions to assist with all facets of strategy development, business planning and financial analysis.
  • Produce pricing analysis and costings when required for new/existing models or price changes for bikes and non-bikes
  • Build and maintain robust financial models and scenarios analyses for strategic decision support
  • Support manufacturing cost analysis
  • Validation of pricing walk as per SBP vs Actual cost /Margins for Bikes
  • Keep track of inventory ageing (Bikes and Non Bikes) and work on actions to clear inventory, financials provisioning.
  • Ensure all stock reconciliations are matched with SAP and physical warehouse stock.
  • Update and maintain weekly cash flow forecast to reflect the latest business position.
  • Track business performance against KPIs.
  • Review of Trial Balance on monthly basis and ensuring check of long aged items , control accounts and expenses
  • Ensure proper governance of processes and support Internal Control/ Compliance framework.
  • Provide ad hoc support to Finance Lead when required.

Education/ Experience:

  • Partly qualified Chartered Accountant /MBA
  • 5+ years relevant experience in a relevant role
  • Good Excel/ Google Sheets knowledge, Power BI
  • Fluent in English Language
  • Reporting of monthly Financial Accounts
  • Excellent Presentation skills
  • Excellent Communication skills
  • Fluent in English Language
  • Knowledge of SAP system
  • Knowledge of Local Taxes; Direct/ Indirect Tax knowledge
  • You will have 4 Wheeler/ 2 wheeler company experience

Royal Enfield - About Us

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling .

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

*Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: Art Director / Creative Director - Motion Graphics & Interactivity
description:
Art Director / Creative Director – Motion Graphics & Interactivity

About Us

At BlueNovius, we transform complex medical and scientific information into explainer videos and interactive experiences that inspire, educate, and engage. Our clients include many of the world’s top 100 pharmaceutical companies, and our work helps global audiences understand innovations that directly impact healthcare and lives.

We’re not just creating visuals, we’re shaping how science and medicine are communicated worldwide.

The Role

We’re seeking an Art Director / Creative Director to lead the creative vision of our Motion Graphics and Interactivity team. This is a leadership role where you’ll set creative standards, drive innovation, and ensure that all visual output, from storyboards to interactive video interfaces, meets the highest levels of creative and strategic excellence.

You’ll combine creative leadership with strategic thinking, particularly in shaping our approach to interactive experiences and motion graphics. You’ll review and sign off on key deliverables while guiding the creative development of complex medical communication projects.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the visual development process across projects, establishing creative standards and innovative approaches to medical storytelling.
  • Review, refine, and sign off on client-facing design deliverables, ensuring they exceed expectations.
  • Mentor and guide designers on both creative and technical aspects, fostering growth and consistency.
  • Translate complex medical and scientific data into visuals that balance creativity with clarity.
  • Collaborate with design leads, medical writers, and project managers to optimize workflows across the design-to-animation pipeline.
  • Ensure all assets are designed with motion and interactivity in mind, integrating seamlessly into After Effects and Figma workflows.
  • Champion UX methodologies (design thinking, user-centered design) in interactive projects to ensure intuitive user experiences.
  • Act as a key point of contact for design-related questions, maintaining clear communication across creative and project management teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of professional experience in art or creative direction, with proven leadership experience.
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects) and Figma, with a strong grasp of animation principles and production pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to set creative direction, establish visual standards, and inspire teams to exceed expectations.
  • Proven ability to apply UX frameworks (design thinking, user-centered design) to interactive and product-driven projects.
  • Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities and confident presenting creative decisions.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly with international, remote teams.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Experience with Windows-based workflows (not Mac).

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare or pharma-related visual communication.
  • Rigging or advanced motion design skills.
  • Availability to work on a US schedule (12 pm – 8:30 pm CET).

description:

  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes).
  • Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.

Descrição do Cargo:

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas é a pessoa fundamental para conectar nosso portfólio de vinhos ao cliente final. Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.

  • Acompanhar as metas de vendas individuais e da loja (resultados, positivações) e propor ações para atingi-las.

  • Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia.

Local / Location: Base: Natal, RN – Atuação: Nordeste do Brasil

Employment Type: CLT (Brazilian labor contract)

Remuneração / Compensation: Compatível com o mercado + participação sobre receitas da empresa.

Competitive salary + performance-based revenue share.

Sobre a Acquatrat / About Acquatrat

A Acquatrat é uma empresa especializada em tratamento e reuso de água, com foco em soluções industriais e de saneamento. Atuamos no projeto, implantação e gestão de ativos e plantas de tratamento de água e efluentes, promovendo o uso racional e sustentável dos recursos hídricos. Estamos em expansão e buscamos incorporar novas tecnologias, como ultrafiltração, osmose reversa e sistemas avançados de reuso, consolidando nossa atuação nos principais polos industriais do Nordeste.

Acquatrat is a Brazilian company specialized in water treatment and reuse, focused on industrial and sanitation solutions. We operate in the design, implementation, and management of water and wastewater treatment plants and assets, promoting sustainable and efficient water use. As part of our expansion, we are incorporating new technologies, such as ultrafiltration, reverse osmosis, and advanced water reuse systems, strengthening our presence across the main industrial regions of Northeastern Brazil.

Descrição da Vaga / Position Overview

Buscamos um Business Development Manager para liderar o desenvolvimento comercial da Acquatrat no Nordeste, com foco na prospecção e gestão de novos negócios junto a indústrias de uso intensivo de água, tais como: Têxtil, farmacêutica, petroquímica, óleo e gás, aciarias, siderúrgicas, psicultura, irrigação, agroindústria e alimentícia.

We are seeking a Business Development Manager to lead Acquatrat’s commercial development across Northeastern Brazil, focusing on prospecting and managing new business opportunities with water-intensive industries such as textile, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, oil & gas, steel, aquaculture, irrigation, agribusiness, and food industries.

Responsabilidades / Responsibilities

- Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais e de relacionamento.

- Prospectar e gerenciar contas estratégicas em indústrias e concessionárias.

- Promover soluções completas de tratamento e reuso de água, incluindo gestão de ativos e operação de plantas.

- Trabalhar com engenharia e operações na elaboração de propostas.

- Acompanhar tendências de mercado e oportunidades em licitações.

- Develop and implement business development and client relationship strategies.

- Prospect and manage key accounts in industrial and utility sectors.

- Promote integrated water treatment and reuse solutions, including asset management and plant operations.

- Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to prepare technical and commercial proposals.

- Monitor market trends and identify opportunities in industrial projects.

Requisitos / Requirements

- Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, saneamento industrial ou gestão de plantas de tratamento de água e efluentes.

- Conhecimento em tecnologias de ultrafiltração e osmose reversa é um diferencial.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Sênior
description:
Sobre a Liquiditi

A Liquiditi é uma fintech em rápido crescimento, pronta para revolucionar o mercado financeiro brasileiro com um produto inédito. Estamos em fase de criação de nossa equipe de engenharia e buscamos talentos de alto nível para nos ajudar a construir a base de um software de trading de ponta. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora sênior que busca desafios técnicos complexos e quer ter impacto real e direto no produto , venha construir o futuro do mercado financeiro conosco.

O Desafio

Sua principal missão será integrar o founding team de tecnologia, que irá estruturar e construir a base do nosso software de trading . Isso significa trabalhar com sistemas de alta performance e escala, onde cada milissegundo conta. Você fará parte de uma equipe pequena, mas de altíssimo nível, onde seu trabalho terá um impacto direto no produto e na estratégia da empresa. Valorizamos a capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e de liderar soluções. Você terá um papel fundamental na criação de um produto do zero.

Responsabilidades

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver a base do nosso software de trading em Rust , Python e Go .
  • Projetar e otimizar a arquitetura de banco de dados, trabalhando principalmente com PostgreSQL .
  • Garantir a escalabilidade e a performance dos sistemas em nuvem, lidando com grandes volumes de dados onde a latência é crítica.
  • Colaborar diretamente com o time de produto e os fundadores para traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Participar ativamente das decisões de arquitetura e do desenvolvimento da cultura de engenharia da Liquiditi.

O que Buscamos

  • Experiência Sênior: Você deve ter experiência na construção de softwares em escala. Buscamos profissionais capazes de se adaptar rapidamente ao crescimento da empresa.
  • Afinidade com nossa stack: Experiência com Rust, Python, Go e/ou PostgreSQL são diferenciais, mas valorizamos a capacidade de aplicar conhecimentos de diferentes linguagens e ecossistemas, compreendendo que a tecnologia é uma ferramenta e o foco está em usar a melhor solução para o problema.
  • Conhecimento em Mercado Financeiro: Experiência anterior em segmentos como pagamentos, investimentos ou e-commerce no mercado financeiro será um diferencial, impulsionando a integração no time e o crescimento profissional na empresa.
  • Autonomia e Protagonismo: Valorizamos indivíduos que se destacam em cenários de incerteza, que prosperam em solucionar desafios complexos e que buscam autonomia na tomada de decisões.

O que Oferecemos

  • Remuneração: Oferecemos um pacote salarial competitivo, alinhado com as práticas de mercado, e a oportunidade de participação em programas de bonificação e/ou de stock options , permitindo que você participe ativamente dos ganhos e do crescimento da nossa empresa.
  • Flexibilidade: Vaga no modelo PJ com horários e benefícios flexíveis, alinhando necessidades e expectativas.
  • Impacto Genuíno: Você fará parte da fundação do time de tecnologia. Sua voz será ouvida e suas decisões serão cruciais para formar a cultura e o roadmap da área.
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Em um time em constante expansão, oferecemos excelentes oportunidades para o seu desenvolvimento profissional, com planos de carreira de liderança técnica e de pessoas.

Se você está pronto(a) para um desafio que vai muito além de escrever código, e quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe no mercado, a Liquiditi é o seu lugar.

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Experiência com PO em projetos Grandes e críticos, escrita de histórias e priorização de demandas.

Vivencia em mercado financeiro.

Atuando com Maximizar e gerenciar o valor do produto

Definir Prioridades;

Atuar com projetos de para o Mobile será um diferencial relevante.

Vaga Híbrida em São Paulo, Interlagos.

CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Scrum Master
description:
A Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) é líder global em serviços de TI, consultoria & soluções de negócios com uma grande rede de centros de inovação & entrega.

Fomos reconhecidos como um Global Top Employer e nossa capacidade de fornecer carreiras holísticas de longo prazo baseadas em aprendizado contínuo impulsionado por nosso ecossistema de aprendizagem digital nos ajuda a desenvolver os melhores talentos!

E convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Scrum Master em projetos complexos, de grande porte, com múltiplos times ou stakeholders;
  • Conhecimento profundo das práticas, cerimônias, papéis e valores do Scrum, com capacidade de orientar o time e a organização na adoção do ágil;
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de gestão ágil, com destaque para Jira;
  • Capacidade de analisar e acompanhar métricas ágeis relevantes (velocidade, lead time, cycle time, burndown, throughput, etc.) para suportar a tomada de decisão e impulsionar a melhoria contínua;
  • Habilidade para facilitar workshops, dinâmicas, resolução de conflitos e promover melhoria contínua;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente para conversação (obrigatório).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com projetos no modelo tradicional (Waterfall), com boa capacidade de transitar entre abordagens ágeis e preditivas conforme a necessidade;
  • Certificação PSM I ou II;
  • Certificação SAFe;
  • Certificação PMI;
  • Experiência anterior em projetos globais, atuando com times distribuídos e multiculturais;
  • Vivência em outras práticas ágeis além do Scrum, como Kanban, Lean ou práticas DevOps.

Modelo de contratação:

  • CLT Full + Benefícios

Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de descontos com Universidades e escolas de idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita

Operamos em escala global, com diversas bases de talentos representando 156 nacionalidades, em 55 países. Na Tata Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, sempre trabalhamos pela equidade. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Diversidade de experiências e Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas vagas são trabalhadas com esses princípios.

title: Assistente de Planejamento e Controle de Materiais
description:
A JTEKT Brasil é uma empresa de destaque no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua qualidade e compromisso com a inovação. Presente no Brasil desde 1998, iniciou suas operações como Koyo e, em 2006, tornou-se JTEKT após uma fusão com a renomada companhia japonesa Toyoda.

Em São Paulo, contamos com um escritório comercial especializado em rolamentos , dando continuidade à expertise da antiga Koyo e fortalecendo ainda mais a presença global da JTEKT no país. Nosso time está dedicado a oferecer soluções técnicas e comerciais sob medida, atendendo clientes de diferentes segmentos com agilidade, confiabilidade e proximidade.

Somos certificados pelas normas internacionais de qualidade, como IATF 16949 e ISO 14001, e seguimos crescendo com foco em excelência e sustentabilidade. Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso!

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Análise de demandas dos clientes, comparando releases e ajustando previsões.
  • Acompanhamento do planejamento de produção das plantas fornecedoras (Japão/EUA), garantindo equilíbrio de estoque e evitando rupturas.
  • Interface com vendas para inquiries e pedidos SPOT.
  • Follow-up de entregas com fornecedores, logística e compras.
  • Suporte na elaboração e atualização de relatórios gerenciais e projeções de estoque/entrega.
  • Contato com fornecedores internacionais, agendamento de coletas e alinhamento com agentes de carga.
  • Apoio aos processos de importação/exportação e atividades de suporte ao cliente.
  • Comunicação contínua com outras áreas para decisões relacionadas à capacidade produtiva.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino superior em andamento em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência ou experiência em PCP será considerada um diferencial;
  • Inglês em nível intermediário.

Horário de trabalho:

  • De segunda a sexta-feira, das 08:00 às 17:00.

Remuneração e Benefícios:

  • PLR e Abono Salarial;
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento gratuito;
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico;
  • Previdência Privada.
